question: The bank rate in the Indian economy is determined by the ______.

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** is responsible for determining the **bank rate **in India.
